A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TR-DPO/TR-IPO/TR-KTO research. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices support reliable comparison despite substantial reorganization.

before.justification: v2 reports original Pythia experiments on Anthropic-HH and Reddit TL;DR, including preference comparisons, human-centric scores, and training-dynamics analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains those empirical results and adds original Llama3 benchmark evaluations, toy-MDP simulations, probability analyses, and hyperparameter experiments.

M1.justification: The soft parameter-averaging and periodic hard-copy rules remain unchanged, as do the underlying DPO, IPO, and KTO objectives (v2 Equations 5–6; v3 Equations 8–9). Explicit stop-gradient notation and clarified parameter replacement document the existing procedure rather than establish a new method.

E1.justification: v3 retains Anthropic-HH and Reddit TL;DR and adds general instruction-following coverage through UltraChat-200k, UltraFeedback, AlpacaEval 2, and Arena-Hard. It also evaluates a synthetic trajectory-preference task in a toy MDP, substantially broadening the training and evaluation domains.

E2.justification: DPO, IPO, and KTO remain the principal comparison methods. However, v2 Figure 1's Pythia comparison against SFT on Anthropic-HH disappears; SFT instead appears in the new Llama3 benchmark comparison. Newly cited methods such as SimPO and Nash-based approaches are not evaluated as additional comparators.

E3.justification: v3 adds Llama3-Base/Instruct protocols, including PairRM selection among eight generated responses, length-controlled win rates, and GPT-4-1106-preview benchmark judging. It also introduces toy-RNN and matched-KL probability-analysis protocols. The reported Reddit preference-validation size changes from 26,198 to 21,198 (v2 Section 4.1; v3 Table 4), without establishing that retained experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: New analyses test ID/OOD probability dynamics in toy MDPs, chosen/rejected sequence probabilities on Anthropic-HH, and hyperparameter sensitivity through expanded Pythia and Llama3 sweeps (v3 Appendices B, C, and E). Existing HC, KL, and diversity analyses largely remain, but v2's IPO/KTO gradient-time-course analyses are removed.

E5.justification: Beyond v2's Fisher tests and bootstrap PoI intervals, v3 reports 100 different seeds with means and standard deviations for toy simulations, plus benchmark standard deviations and 95% confidence intervals. Existing Fisher and PoI results remain, although the explicit bootstrap-description sentence disappears. The new reporting does not establish repeated LLM training runs.

E6.justification: Main Table 1 and the Fisher-test results are unchanged. v3 adds extensive benchmark, simulation, and ablation results; for example, Table 2 reports Llama3-Base Arena-Hard scores of 21.3 for TR-DPOα versus 10.5 for DPO. v2's SFT-relative scores and IPO/KTO gradient traces disappear. New Table 6 also reports a 22.8% tie rate for TR-DPO at α = 0.5, conflicting with the retained 21.8% result.

T1.justification: v3 introduces the DPO Hessian and its derivation (Equation 7 and Appendix A), substantially changing the mathematical analysis. Conversely, v2's explicit KL-constrained trust-region objective and IPO/KTO gradient derivations are removed. The rearranged DPO gradient itself is algebraically equivalent to the earlier expression.

C1.justification: v2 centers its contribution on overcoming an unnecessarily restrictive static reference policy. v3 makes mitigation of offline reward overoptimization a central claim and explicitly extends claimed effectiveness to general-purpose Llama3 assistants. This changes the principal scientific framing and claimed application scope while retaining the reference-update contribution.

C2.justification: v3 introduces a vanishing-curvature/reset hypothesis and interprets preserved sequence probabilities as reduced leakage into OOD outputs. It replaces broad near-optimality claims for α = 0.6 and τ = 512 with task-dependent guidance, acknowledges mixed KTO results and absent KTO toy overoptimization, and adds limitations concerning large update intervals on small datasets.

D1.justification: v3 documents toy-RNN dimensions and training trajectories, Llama3 training and generation settings, new dataset access information, and additional licensing details (Appendices B, D, and F). Pythia settings, hardware, training-time information, and judging prompts are retained. The explicit KTO setting λw = λl = 1 from v2 Appendix D.2 is omitted.

R1.justification: Related work is substantially repositioned around overoptimization, adding Gao, Coste, and Rafailov studies and contrasting offline TR methods with online Nash approaches by Rosset and Munos. The earlier target-network/EMA motivation and TRPO citation disappear, while new alignment, dataset, and benchmark references expand the research context.

P1.justification: The abstract, contributions, related work, motivation, and discussion are substantially rewritten around overoptimization. Methods gain separate motivation and implementation subsections; experimental setup is subdivided; HC discussion moves into the appendix; and appendix organization is extensively revised. These changes exceed routine renumbering or added scientific paragraphs.

P2.justification: The opening SFT comparison is replaced by two benchmark panels, and v3 adds MDP/probability figures and benchmark/ablation tables. Existing KL panels are combined into Figure 5, HC plots are relocated, DPO gradient axes are rescaled, and IPO/KTO gradient panels disappear. The title, headers, typography, and overall page layout also change.

improvement.justification: The Llama3 evaluations and probability-dynamics experiments substantially address v2's narrow empirical coverage and largely speculative mechanism explanation. Hyperparameter sweeps also replace overbroad default-setting claims with better-supported guidance. These gains outweigh removed gradient analyses and reporting inconsistencies, including TR-KTOα's Arena-Hard score of 15.3 in v3 Figure 1 versus 14.9 in Table 2. The proposed mechanism remains a hypothesis rather than a demonstrated guarantee.
